about: Measured on GitHub's runner by the gate on every push: each organ's tests, then its witness mutation gate. tools/facts.mjs writes this file from those runs and the gate fails if the committed copy differs. The page reads it.

survivors.reason: Genuinely equivalent: the mutated bound runs one extra schedule iteration that writes w[64], out of bounds on the fixed Uint32Array(64) — typed-array OOB writes are silently discarded, the loop body has no other side effect, and nothing reads past w[63]. Behaviour is bit-identical; the FIPS vectors pass either way.
